Groceries

Shop for fresh food like a local at any Thai market or supermarket. This beginner topic covers tropical fruit — มังคุด (mangosteen), ทุเรียน (durian) and ส้มโอ (pomelo) — and everyday vegetables like ผักบุ้ง (morning glory) and ต้นหอม (spring onions). You'll buy by the ขีด (100 grams), count produce with classifiers such as หวี (bunch) and ฝัก (cob), and express when things have หมด (run out) and say what's เหลือ (left). All 38 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the market vocabulary settles in by ear.
